value.rationale: Two disjoint equal-measure quarter-holes are the smallest symmetric Markov pair for the doubling map. The result gives the exact globally optimal finite-time schedule with equality uniqueness and sharp exponential escape extremes, and distinguishes countable zero-dimensional from uncountable positive-dimensional eternal survivors. This resolves a natural placement-control problem rather than merely recasting a fixed-hole Fibonacci count.
